BALOCHISTAN PURE
FOOD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the
Balochistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 31st December 2001]
No. Legis. 2-46/Law/79-IV dated 31-12-2001.----The following
Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan in 21st December,
2001, is hereby published for general information:-
Short
title and commencement.-----(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Balochistan Pure Food (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.

Amendment of section 35 of  W. P. Ordinance VII of 1960

ORDINANCE LV OF 2001
ORDINANCE LV OF
2001
BALOCHISTAN PURE
FOOD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the
Balochistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 31st December 2001]
No. Legis. 2-46/Law/79-IV dated 31-12-2001.----The following
Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan in 21st December,
2001, is hereby published for general information:-
Amendment
of section 35 of W. P. Ordinance
VII of 1960.---In the Balochistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960, in
section 35:--
(a)
In subsection (1), for the words Deputy Commissioner of a
District the words Assistant Director Food Shall be substituted.
(b)
In subsection (2), for the words Deputy Commissioner the words Assistant Director Food Shall be
substituted.
(c)
In subsection (3), for words Deputy Commissioner the words
Assistant Director Food shall be substituted.
